description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM installation process. It contains PHP classes and functions responsible for generating the installation UI, handling configuration forms, dynamically creating HTML content, managing errors, and including class definitions for localization and layout. It appears to be a core component of the installer interface, enabling configuration of database, localization, site, and branding settings.

classes.name: NonDBLocalization
classes.description: Class responsible for localization-related functionalities, such as filtering locale name options and generating dropdowns for locale name formats.

classes.name: InstallLayout
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering layout components of the installation UI, including forms, headers, scripts, and error handling.

classes.name: DisplayErrors
classes.description: Utility class to manage error display settings, enabling error reporting and restoration.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the installation interface by assembling header, form, scripts, and layout components.

methods.name: getSelect
methods.description: Static method to generate HTML select elements with given options.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Constructs the full HTML page output for the installer, including header, body, and footer.
